## @opentui/core-win32-x64

> Prebuilt win32-x64 binaries for `@opentui/core`.

`opentui.h` beside `opentui.dll` is the C ABI header that this library was built from (FNV-1a 64 `0x32e4ccfcdaff96ec`). A C host compiles against it and links the library in this directory through `opentui.lib`. For opentui-rust, set `OPENTUI_LIB_DIR` to this directory; its build fails when the header differs from the one its bindings were generated from. See [C](https://opentui.com/docs/native/c).
